     1	import dlt
     2	from pyspark.sql.functions import col, current_timestamp
     3	from pyspark.sql.types import *
     4	from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
     5	
     6	spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()
     7	catalog = spark.conf.get("catalog")
     8	pipeline_schema = spark.conf.get("pipeline_schema")
     9	volume = spark.conf.get("volume")
    10	file_path = f"/Volumes/{catalog}/{pipeline_schema}/{volume}/consumer_order/"
    11	
    12	# Explicit schema from metadata_consumer_order.json
    13	schema = StructType([
    14	    StructField("order_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    15	    StructField("consumer_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    16	    StructField("order_date", StringType(), nullable=True),
    17	    StructField("order_status", StringType(), nullable=True),
    18	    StructField("total_amount", DoubleType(), nullable=True),
    19	    StructField("currency", StringType(), nullable=True),
    20	    StructField("payment_method", StringType(), nullable=True),
    21	    StructField("channel", StringType(), nullable=True),
    22	    StructField("billing_address", StringType(), nullable=True),
    23	    StructField("shipping_address", StringType(), nullable=True),
    24	    StructField("operation", StringType(), nullable=False)
    25	])
    26	
    27	@dlt.view(name="raw_consumer_order")
    28	def raw_consumer_order():
    29	    df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles") \
    30	        .option("cloudFiles.format", "json") \
    31	        .option("multiline", "true") \
    32	        .schema(schema) \
    33	        .load(file_path)
    34	    return df.withColumn("ingestion_time", current_timestamp())
    35	
    36	dlt.create_streaming_table("consumer_order_cdc_stream")
    37	
    38	dlt.apply_changes(
    39	    target="consumer_order_cdc_stream",
    40	    source=dlt.read("raw_consumer_order"),
    41	    keys=["order_id"],
    42	    sequence_by=col("ingestion_time"),
    43	    apply_as_deletes=col("operation") == "delete",
    44	    except_column_list=["operation", "ingestion_time"],
    45	    stored_as_scd_type=2
    46	)
